result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces. However, safety is compromised by significantly faded crosswalk markings and a large tree that obstructs sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are heavily worn, making the pedestrian crossing zone less visible to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree on the corner blocks the line of sight between pedestrians waiting to cross and vehicles approaching the intersection.

hazards.name: Debris and Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Accumulated debris and cracking near the storm drain and curb ramp create potential tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Gutter and curb ramp area in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility for motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune the lower branches of the corner tree to restore clear sightlines at the pedestrian crossing level.

result.summary: The intersection features sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps with tactile paving, but lacks marked crosswalks and active traffic control. The wide, open nature of the intersection increases pedestrian exposure to vehicles without providing a designated crossing path.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of curb ramps, there are no painted crosswalks to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at the intersection where pedestrians are expected to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure no parking is allowed near the corners to maintain clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and ADA-compliant curb ramps featuring tactile paving. While sidewalks are present and in good condition, parked cars near the crossing and the lack of active traffic control or signage may impact pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left and right curbs approaching the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
